description: Wednesday 19:40: Joanne uploads a new version of 'Ellery seller questionnaire.pdf' in the shared 5759 folder (same file, new head revision): the typed answers page is unchanged, and page 2, a picture only, is her phone photo of Bayview Roofing's June 2021 invoice: a leak repair over the living room (14 shingles, vent boot, flashing), not a roof replacement. The mail lands unread. The page's edit time moves. Nothing announces any of them.

Joanne
